title: ambiguous-apikey-tenant-binding-on-token-reconcile
creator: Miguel Ortega
description: Summary: Multiple customers (Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments) reported authorization anomalies where valid API keys occasionally granted access under an incorrect tenant context after token refresh reconciliation. Impact: transient cross-tenant authorization checks and noisy 403/200 flip-flops for affected endpoints. Root cause hypothesis: the token refresh reconciliation path performs an alias lookup with a compatibility fallback to the primary tenant when the tenant-mapping microservice is unavailable or returns transient errors. Combined with an async cache invalidation window between the tenant-mapping cache and the session KV cache, API keys could be temporarily bound to the wrong org_id. This allowed requests to be accepted under a different tenant until caches converged. Scope: observed in production for multiple customers across hosted and dedicated pools and one on-prem private deployment. Immediate mitigation and long-term plan below.
comments: 2026-03-11 08:12 - Triage: SRE alerted via pager; initial triage found 3 escalations (acct-987, acct-124, acct-553) reporting unexpected authorization outcomes. Assigned to auth oncall.

2026-03-11 09:03 - Repro: QA reproduced locally by simulating tenant-mapper 503 + delayed cache eviction; observed apiKey binding updated to fallback org when reconciliation returned error. Evidence attached to incident doc.

2026-03-11 11:20 - Mitigation applied: disabled compatibility fallback flag in runtime config (feature flag: auth.strictTenantResolve=true) for all hosted and dedicated regions; invalidated tenant-mapper cache TTLs across edge nodes. Immediate reduction of noisy cases observed.
2026-03-11 14:40 - Hotfix: landed small runtime patch to enforce org_id assertion on token refresh path (PR linked). Canary deployed to us-east-1 with 5% traffic; no regressions in latency.
2026-03-12 02:15 - Customer comms: support notified affected accounts with temporary mitigation details and ETA for full fix. Customer PMs looped in for dedicated/private contracts.
2026-03-12 09:00 - Post-fix monitoring: added metric auth.refresh_mismatch_count and increased sampling on token-refresh traces for 72 hours. Alerts set at >5/min sustained.

2026-03-13 16:55 - Code review feedback: Security requested an additional verification step that refreshed sessions include authoritative tenant_stamp signed by tenant-mapper; engineering agreed to implement before broad rollout.

2026-03-14 10:30 - Current plan: finish authoritative tenant_stamp implementation, add unit + e2e test simulating mapper failures, run a 10% canary across regions for 24h, then GA. Remaining work owner: Aisha Kumar.

Postmortem follow-up: schedule incident review with Product and Security week of 2026-03-22. Action items: align cache TTLs, remove compatibility fallback in code, add synthetic test harness for tenant-mapper downtime scenarios.
